presets.name: Endless phase
presets.desc: Every partial moved up 0.3 Hz against the dry: notches that climb for ever and never turn round
presets.notes: The barber-pole phaser with no feedback: the dry beats against the shifted wet; 50 % mix gives the deepest notches

presets.name: Spiral phaser
presets.desc: A dense barber-pole phaser: the shifted wet fed back through a twelve-stage all-pass chain
presets.notes: Costello's recipe: a dispersive loop around the shifter; more feedback, sharper notches

presets.name: Falling flanger
presets.desc: Comb teeth that glide down for ever: a 3 ms loop shifted −0.4 Hz on every pass
presets.notes: A short delay in the loop turns the barber-pole phaser into a flanger; the loop high cut keeps the teeth smooth

presets.name: Wide metallic detune
presets.desc: Left shifted up 1.5 Hz, right down 1.5 Hz, 12 ms late: a sweet metallic chorus that spreads wide
presets.notes: Opposite stereo shifts; summed to mono they are both sidebands, a slow ring-mod shimmer

presets.name: Whole-band swell
presets.desc: The whole chord swells and fades four times a second: the dry matched to the wet's phase
presets.notes: Dry Match puts every partial's beat in phase: a tremolo made of beating, not a phaser

presets.name: Bell lead
presets.desc: Every partial moved up 180 Hz: harmonics turn inharmonic, single notes ring like bells
presets.notes: Inharmonic partials over a dry core; play single notes, chords turn to clang

presets.name: Carrier-free ring mod
presets.desc: Both sidebands at ±400 Hz, no carrier and no dry: a clean ring modulator
presets.notes: Sideband 0 mixes the shift and its mirror at −6 dB each: a sine ring modulator without carrier bleed

presets.name: Through-zero swirl
presets.desc: The shift swings ±3 Hz around zero: the phasing slows, stops and reverses on a slow cycle
presets.notes: The oscillator's phase is continuous, so crossing 0 Hz never steps

presets.name: Pick zap
presets.desc: Each pick attack pushes the shift up to 600 Hz and lets it fall back: a zap on every note
presets.notes: The envelope drives the shift in Hz; play staccato for separate zaps

presets.name: Falling ghost echoes
presets.desc: Echoes 350 ms apart, each one 30 Hz lower and thinner than the last
presets.notes: Zero Cut keeps the falling repeats from folding back into mud below 0 Hz

presets.name: Rising spiral echoes
presets.desc: Quarter-second echoes that climb 12 Hz per repeat and darken as they go
presets.notes: A shifter in a delay loop; Zero Cut also removes what climbs past Nyquist

presets.name: Runaway wall
presets.desc: Feedback past 100 %: the loop builds into a bounded, ever-rising wall; lower it to recover
presets.notes: Meant for an EXP pedal on Feedback; the soft clip on the return keeps it bounded

presets.name: Bass growl
presets.desc: Bass shifted 60 Hz down with the zero cut off: low notes fold back through 0 Hz and growl
presets.notes: The through-zero reflection on purpose; mixed low so the fundamental stays

presets.name: Radio ghost
presets.desc: A 24 Hz shift with a short, faint loop and a nearly dry right side: a voice between stations
presets.notes: The catalogue's radio-ghost converted to real units (README §3.4)

presets.name: Metal smear
presets.desc: Partials moved up 40 Hz on the left, 16 Hz on the right, smeared by a 15 ms loop
presets.notes: The catalogue's metal-smear converted to real units (README §3.4)

presets.name: Barber pole
presets.desc: A 4 Hz shift in a 144 ms loop: echoes that each beat faster, a slow spinning pole
presets.notes: The catalogue's barberpole in real units, with Shift R at +100 % (R = L) as its author meant
